purpose: Exploratory search for conditions favoring complex HNNs; retain all outcomes and do not modify manuscript or established experiments.
fixed_model: Original two-mode cosine Hamiltonian, Eq36 conservative midpoint data; same 673 real parameters.

signal_strength.scope: Computational stress case of the same small-slope model; angle gate is a screening rule, not a physical validation.

screening: Use common held-out validation states and continuous gradient error to nominate at most one setting; report all pilot conditions and failures. Rollout gains must be judged against the original continuous reference at fine steps, with physical H0 baseline.
candidate_rule: At least 5 percent mean paired relative improvement and at least 4/5 directional seed wins on both primary metrics for a credible exploratory candidate; no formal significance or universal superiority claim.
confirmation: If a promising training change is found, evaluate the frozen nominated setting on five new seeds/data sets before suggesting a paper claim. An advantage on one output only is reported as output-specific.
statistics: Seed is the repetition unit; paired data/splits/initials within seed; never use time points as independent replicates.
source_protection: All pre-existing results, manuscript files and production scripts are hashed in protected_manifest.json.

selection_amendment_before_pilot_results.weight_selection: Original fixed 2048-point validation subset, every100 updates; validation noise matches the declared training noise amplitude and is independently drawn. Full clean validation set only for reporting/nomination.
selection_amendment_before_pilot_results.nomination_score: Mean over pilot seeds of log(clean full-validation gradient RMS_GR / clean full-validation gradient RMS_GC), using the same per-component output scale within each pair. Compare ratios, not raw errors across different amplitudes.
selection_amendment_before_pilot_results.eligible_nomination: Positive mean score and GC better in at least2 of3 seeds; largest score across prespecified training settings nominates at most one setting for fresh-seed confirmation. Include baseline full12/10k reference. Fine-step-only findings remain fixed-weight diagnostics.
selection_amendment_before_pilot_results.confirmation_condition: Chosen setting and training updates fixed before evaluating fresh-seed test trajectories; compare GR/GC and H0 on same data and small common step. Report both primary outcomes including disagreements.
